decisions.reason: The sports flooring system is distant from the firm's core residential wood-flooring knowledge and serves an unfamiliar sports-facility market, limiting the firm's ability to interpret early results and improve it.
The mobile arena sports floor system requires specialised sports-performance knowledge and customer channels the firm does not have, reducing its absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback.
Like the other mobile arena system, this product is outside the firm's established interior floor knowledge and distribution, so early results are hard to assimilate and act on.
Chevron parquet directly builds on the firm's established wood-surface know-how and is a strategic flagship, so the firm can recognise, assimilate and apply learning to improve it.
Although related to wood finishing, the squash court finish has niche performance requirements and a customer segment that falls outside the firm's core absorptive capacity.
Oak skirting for sports floors is only partly aligned with the firm's residential accessories and cannot be easily leveraged by its existing interior-focused knowledge and retailer network.
